thesis: Lived succession arises when a finite subject cannot hold manifestation all at once: exclusion creates a moving now, memory leaves traces, anticipation opens branches, and recognition can reveal sequence inside a wider field.

continuity_material.name: temporal exposure field
continuity_material.initial: Gold and spectral event paths coexist as simultaneous layers.
continuity_material.stress: A cyan moving shutter exposes only a narrow slice, leaving traces behind and branches ahead.
continuity_material.integrated: The timeline remains useful but is revealed as one selective exposure inside the larger field.

color_roles.gold: simultaneous manifestation, retained whole, and integrated meaning
color_roles.cyan: finite now, exposed sequence, and attention slit
color_roles.blue: past trace, measurement, and unavailable context
color_roles.magenta: desire, fear, contraction, and temporal pressure

arc.latent: Many temporal relations coexist without waiting.
arc.formation: Exclusion, now, sequence, trace, anticipation, identity, and language create personal time.
arc.stress: Desire, fear, boredom, measurement, contraction, and finitude deform duration.
arc.revision: Flash, music, meditation, science, and caution show alternate access to temporal structure.
arc.integration: Recognition widens the shutter and reveals sequence within simultaneity.

scenes.claim: Temporal relations can coexist before finite succession selects among them.
scenes.topology: many event paths inside one field
scenes.material_state: spectral simultaneous strata
scenes.u_semantics: Separate paths become legible as one whole field.
scenes.t_semantics: Each layer moves at a different phase without queueing.
scenes.audio_volume_semantics: Volume increases depth between simultaneous layers.
scenes.audio_beat_semantics: Beats reveal cross-layer correspondences.
scenes.glance_thesis: Everything need not wait in line to be related.
scenes.rationale: Layered paths establish simultaneity without a frozen block diagram.
scenes.risk: Density may look chaotic.
scenes.review_target: One enclosing gold relation must remain visible.

scenes.claim: Finite attention creates time by excluding most of the field.
scenes.topology: simultaneous field through a moving shutter
scenes.material_state: darkened field with cyan aperture
scenes.u_semantics: A wide field narrows until only one region remains available.
scenes.t_semantics: The slit moves while excluded layers continue behind it.
scenes.audio_volume_semantics: Volume increases pressure inside the exposed region.
scenes.audio_beat_semantics: Beats tighten the shutter edges.
scenes.glance_thesis: One event becomes now because others are unavailable.
scenes.rationale: A shutter turns forgetting into a visible constructive operation.
scenes.risk: Dark exclusion could imply annihilation.
scenes.review_target: Keep excluded event paths faintly alive.

scenes.claim: Succession appears when selective exposure orders simultaneous relations.
scenes.topology: field to shutter to activated timeline
scenes.material_state: spectral layers becoming cyan rail
scenes.camera: moves from volume into a single track
scenes.u_semantics: The many-layer field yields an ordered line of activated nodes.
scenes.t_semantics: Activation travels along the new sequence.
scenes.audio_volume_semantics: Volume increases continuity between exposed nodes.
scenes.audio_beat_semantics: Beats snap new moments onto the rail.
scenes.glance_thesis: Sequence is produced by selection, not added from outside.
scenes.rationale: The visual shows the causal transition rather than only before and after.
scenes.risk: Rail imagery may become generic.
scenes.review_target: Keep fading simultaneous strata visible during the transition.

scenes.claim: The now is a moving window rather than a self-contained object.
scenes.topology: timeline intersected by a mobile slice
scenes.material_state: white-cyan temporal slit
scenes.u_semantics: The available window narrows around one moving position.
scenes.t_semantics: The position moves continuously through the rail.
scenes.audio_volume_semantics: Volume increases the slice's field of influence.
scenes.audio_beat_semantics: Beats sharpen the present boundary.
scenes.glance_thesis: The present is an access relation moving through events.
scenes.rationale: Intersection geometry makes now distinct from the timeline itself.
scenes.risk: A bright slit could overstate precision.
scenes.review_target: Use soft influence outside the hard core.

scenes.claim: The past persists as trace and reconstruction, not present availability.
scenes.topology: current event with fading and deforming echoes
scenes.material_state: gold memory echoes behind cyan event
scenes.camera: tracks the current event while history trails
scenes.u_semantics: Faint echoes acquire reconstructive links without becoming present again.
scenes.t_semantics: The current event advances and traces decay.
scenes.audio_volume_semantics: Volume increases trace retention.
scenes.audio_beat_semantics: Beats reactivate selected echoes.
scenes.glance_thesis: The past is absent as now but active as trace.
scenes.rationale: Decay plus reactivation separates memory from storage of intact moments.
scenes.risk: Echoes may imply literal replay.
scenes.review_target: Later traces must visibly distort and weaken.

scenes.claim: The future is an open field narrowed by expectation and action.
scenes.topology: present root to branching possible trajectories
scenes.material_state: blue-gold unrealized branches
scenes.camera: moves from root toward an open horizon
scenes.u_semantics: Faint branches become weighted without becoming completed events.
scenes.t_semantics: Branch geometry continuously recomputes.
scenes.audio_volume_semantics: Volume increases reachable branch depth.
scenes.audio_beat_semantics: Beats temporarily privilege a trajectory.
scenes.glance_thesis: The future is structured openness, not an experienced object.
scenes.rationale: Unclosed branches preserve possibility and agency.
scenes.risk: Branch brightness may imply prediction certainty.
scenes.review_target: Keep endpoints open and materially incomplete.

scenes.claim: Desire accelerates lived time toward an absent good.
scenes.topology: elastic duration pulled by a future attractor
scenes.material_state: cyan curve stretched toward magenta pull
scenes.u_semantics: Even intervals warp toward an attractor.
scenes.t_semantics: Pulses accelerate as they approach the desired region.
scenes.audio_volume_semantics: Volume strengthens temporal pull.
scenes.audio_beat_semantics: Beats compress intervals near the attractor.
scenes.glance_thesis: Wanting changes how duration is spaced.
scenes.rationale: Elastic geometry makes affective time visibly nonuniform.
scenes.risk: Could resemble a generic signal curve.
scenes.review_target: Attractor and interval compression must be obvious together.

scenes.claim: Fear lets one anticipated branch colonize the present field.
scenes.topology: many branches captured by one future pressure center
scenes.material_state: magenta pressure over blue futures
scenes.camera: is pulled toward the dominant branch
scenes.u_semantics: Open branches bend toward one looming possibility.
scenes.t_semantics: Pressure pulses while alternate branches resist.
scenes.audio_volume_semantics: Volume increases capture radius.
scenes.audio_beat_semantics: Beats send contraction waves toward the present.
scenes.glance_thesis: An anticipated future can reorganize the current field.
scenes.rationale: Branch capture communicates colonization without literal threat imagery.
scenes.risk: Magenta mass may overpower nuance.
scenes.review_target: Preserve visible uncaptured alternatives.

scenes.claim: Low difference makes duration feel heavy and extended.
scenes.topology: sparse changes inside stretched equal compartments
scenes.material_state: dim blue slabs and slow magenta curve
scenes.u_semantics: Rhythmic differences flatten and compartments dominate.
scenes.t_semantics: The curve moves slowly despite continuous time.
scenes.audio_volume_semantics: Volume modestly deepens compartments without adding events.
scenes.audio_beat_semantics: Beats remain muted to preserve sparse change.
scenes.glance_thesis: Time expands when little differentiates one moment from the next.
scenes.rationale: Reduced event density expresses heaviness more honestly than slow clocks.
scenes.risk: The scene may become visually dull.
scenes.review_target: Maintain exquisite texture and one legible slow transformation.

scenes.claim: Absorbed activity can compress lived duration into one continuous gesture.
scenes.topology: events merge into a green flow corridor
scenes.material_state: green-cyan continuous gesture
scenes.u_semantics: Separate pulses become one uninterrupted trajectory.
scenes.t_semantics: Energy travels smoothly through the corridor.
scenes.audio_volume_semantics: Volume increases flow reach and coherence.
scenes.audio_beat_semantics: Beats become internal accents rather than interruptions.
scenes.glance_thesis: Continuous engagement makes the clock disappear from experience.
scenes.rationale: A moving corridor contrasts boredom without simply speeding animation.
scenes.risk: Could become decorative motion.
scenes.review_target: Show node-to-gesture integration clearly.

scenes.claim: Memory binds changing moments into the sense of one temporal owner.
scenes.topology: multiple traces braided inside an owner boundary
scenes.material_state: spectral memory strands and gold enclosure
scenes.u_semantics: Independent strands gain one enclosing continuity relation.
scenes.t_semantics: Strands shift without losing the braid.
scenes.audio_volume_semantics: Volume strengthens cross-strand coupling.
scenes.audio_beat_semantics: Beats illuminate remembered intersections.
scenes.glance_thesis: Personal time is woven from traces attributed to one history.
scenes.rationale: A braid preserves difference between events and their ownership.
scenes.risk: Boundary could imply a fixed self.
scenes.review_target: Keep the enclosing contour flexible and derived from strands.

scenes.claim: Language stabilizes past, present, and future into narrative lanes.
scenes.topology: living temporal field to three tense tracks
scenes.material_state: blue, white, and gold symbolic sequences
scenes.camera: pulls back into a linguistic map
scenes.u_semantics: Isolated marks gain directional channels and narrative order.
scenes.t_semantics: Activation travels differently along each tense.
scenes.audio_volume_semantics: Volume increases grammatical linking.
scenes.audio_beat_semantics: Beats lock marks into discrete positions.
scenes.glance_thesis: Tense turns temporal relation into communicable structure.
scenes.rationale: Three lanes make linguistic construction visible without rendered words.
scenes.risk: Could become an abstract typography exercise.
scenes.review_target: Preserve distinct temporal directions for all lanes.

scenes.claim: Measured time can remain uniform while lived time expands and contracts.
scenes.topology: rigid grid beside elastic temporal curve
scenes.material_state: blue metric lattice and gold living interval
scenes.u_semantics: The grid stays fixed while the experiential curve dilates.
scenes.t_semantics: Measurement ticks evenly as the curve changes speed.
scenes.audio_volume_semantics: Volume affects only lived density, not grid spacing.
scenes.audio_beat_semantics: Beats mark equal measures and unequal experience together.
scenes.glance_thesis: One duration can be equal by clock and unequal in experience.
scenes.rationale: A shared frame prevents either time from replacing the other.
scenes.risk: Grid side may appear lifeless.
scenes.review_target: Keep exact rhythm visible on the measurement side.

scenes.claim: Temporal limitation is a contraction of wider capacity, not simple illusion.
scenes.topology: simultaneous field narrowed into a finite window and rail
scenes.material_state: magenta boundary around cyan sequence
scenes.camera: moves from field scale into finite center
scenes.u_semantics: The window contracts while an active timeline forms inside.
scenes.t_semantics: Excluded layers keep moving beyond the frame.
scenes.audio_volume_semantics: Volume increases pressure and activity within limitation.
scenes.audio_beat_semantics: Beats tighten the boundary without erasing the outside.
scenes.glance_thesis: Finite time is real experience produced by limited access.
scenes.rationale: Active outside and inside fields reject both denial and absolutization.
scenes.risk: Window can resemble generic attention imagery.
scenes.review_target: Sequence creation must remain the distinctive content.

scenes.claim: Krama is phase-by-phase order required by finite cognition and action.
scenes.topology: successive gates on an activated timeline
scenes.material_state: cyan sequence with gold thresholds
scenes.u_semantics: Gates become active in a strict sequence.
scenes.t_semantics: Signals move from one phase to the next.
scenes.audio_volume_semantics: Volume strengthens continuity between phases.
scenes.audio_beat_semantics: Beats trigger discrete gate transitions.
scenes.glance_thesis: Finite action requires one phase to become available after another.
scenes.rationale: Thresholds give sequence causal necessity rather than mere chronology.
scenes.risk: May repeat sequence birth.
scenes.review_target: Emphasize ordered gates rather than formation from simultaneity.

scenes.claim: Akrama is non-sequential relation, not endless duration.
scenes.topology: timeline dissolves into an encompassing simultaneous field
scenes.material_state: spectral strata and white outer relation
scenes.camera: pulls back from sequence into a larger dimensional view
scenes.u_semantics: The timeline recedes as simultaneous layers and boundary become primary.
scenes.t_semantics: Layers coexist with independent phase.
scenes.audio_volume_semantics: Volume increases cross-layer relation.
scenes.audio_beat_semantics: Beats reveal nonlocal correspondences.
scenes.glance_thesis: Non-sequence is a different relation, not a very long timeline.
scenes.rationale: Camera reversal changes ontology rather than stretching duration.
scenes.risk: Could imply sequence is false.
scenes.review_target: Keep the cyan line present inside the wider field.

scenes.claim: A whole relation can appear in a flash and be unpacked afterward.
scenes.topology: central event to expanding whole-field wave
scenes.material_state: gold disclosure wave over simultaneous strata
scenes.u_semantics: A point event expands into a field-wide relation.
scenes.t_semantics: Underlying temporal layers remain alive after disclosure.
scenes.audio_volume_semantics: Volume increases the wave's reach.
scenes.audio_beat_semantics: A beat triggers the brightest non-clipping flash.
scenes.glance_thesis: Meaning can arrive as a whole before discursive sequence.
scenes.rationale: A field-changing wave distinguishes insight from another event node.
scenes.risk: Spectacle may overwhelm temporal content.
scenes.review_target: Strata must become newly related by the wave.

scenes.claim: Music holds retention, present tone, and anticipation in one phrase.
scenes.topology: multiple temporal voices to a moving chord boundary
scenes.material_state: spectral phrase layers and gold chord slice
scenes.u_semantics: Independent voices become one temporal harmonic.
scenes.t_semantics: Each voice moves with a distinct phase.
scenes.audio_volume_semantics: Volume deepens harmonic coupling.
scenes.audio_beat_semantics: Beats move the chord boundary through the phrase.
scenes.glance_thesis: A phrase is one gesture made from retained and anticipated relations.
scenes.rationale: Polyphony lets the audience feel simultaneous temporal functions.
scenes.risk: Could become a generic audio visualizer.
scenes.review_target: Keep past-current-future phase offsets visible.

scenes.claim: Finitude gives a lived sequence a boundary that changes its meaning.
scenes.topology: finite timeline ending at an abstract luminous horizon
scenes.material_state: cyan rail meeting white limit
scenes.camera: approaches but does not cross the boundary
scenes.u_semantics: A previously open rail becomes visibly finite.
scenes.t_semantics: Events continue approaching the stable horizon.
scenes.audio_volume_semantics: Volume increases the significance of the finite span.
scenes.audio_beat_semantics: Beats mark intervals before the boundary.
scenes.glance_thesis: A limit changes the weight of every interval before it.
scenes.rationale: A purely abstract horizon communicates finitude without depicting harm or victims.
scenes.risk: The image could become ominous rather than contemplative.
scenes.review_target: Use quiet geometry and restrained color; no graphic or person-like imagery.

scenes.claim: Gaps between thoughts can reveal awareness larger than the sequence.
scenes.topology: pulse train opens a silent central interval
scenes.material_state: blue thoughts around gold silence
scenes.u_semantics: Central pulses recede and a wider observer boundary appears.
scenes.t_semantics: Outer thoughts continue arising and passing.
scenes.audio_volume_semantics: Volume deepens the surrounding field without filling the gap.
scenes.audio_beat_semantics: Beats accent outer pulses, leaving the center quiet.
scenes.glance_thesis: Sequence occurs inside an awareness not exhausted by its events.
scenes.rationale: Negative space makes the gap positive without treating it as blankness.
scenes.risk: Could imply meditation stops thought entirely.
scenes.review_target: Keep outer pulses active through all states.

scenes.claim: Recognition widens finite access and reveals krama inside akrama.
scenes.topology: narrow shutter opens into simultaneous field
scenes.material_state: cyan slice becoming gold field aperture
scenes.camera: pulls back beyond the moving now
scenes.u_semantics: The slit widens until timeline and field are simultaneously visible.
scenes.t_semantics: The now keeps moving inside the wider relation.
scenes.audio_volume_semantics: Volume increases cross-field coherence.
scenes.audio_beat_semantics: Beats phase-lock line and layers during the reveal.
scenes.glance_thesis: Sequence remains real while no longer appearing ultimate.
scenes.rationale: The camera expansion integrates rather than abolishes ordinary time.
scenes.risk: Could read as escapism from time.
scenes.review_target: Keep the functional timeline active in the resolved frame.

scenes.claim: Cognitive mechanisms can explain temporal construction without settling the metaphysics.
scenes.topology: measured sequence beside memory-attention braid
scenes.material_state: blue rail and green living process
scenes.camera: holds explanatory levels side by side
scenes.u_semantics: Functional correspondences appear while a seam remains.
scenes.t_semantics: Measured and lived mechanisms evolve independently.
scenes.audio_volume_semantics: Volume increases detail within both models.
scenes.audio_beat_semantics: Beats reveal functional alignment points.
scenes.glance_thesis: Mechanism clarifies construction without proving the widest claim.
scenes.rationale: A persistent seam disciplines the bridge between levels.
scenes.risk: The sides may seem adversarial.
scenes.review_target: Give both models equal complexity and dignity.

scenes.claim: Constructed lived time does not mean clocks, physics, or sequence are unreal.
scenes.topology: timeline and field held inside an inference frame
scenes.material_state: cyan sequence, spectral field, magenta limit
scenes.u_semantics: The wider field appears without erasing the measured rail.
scenes.t_semantics: Both sequence and simultaneous strata remain active.
scenes.audio_volume_semantics: Volume reveals detail without widening the claim frame.
scenes.audio_beat_semantics: Beats pulse the boundary of inference.
scenes.glance_thesis: A constructed experience can be real and scientifically measurable.
scenes.rationale: A frame turns caution into part of the film's logic.
scenes.risk: May feel like a pause in the drama.
scenes.review_target: Keep the interior visually alive and integrated.

scenes.claim: The timeline is a selective exposure inside the simultaneous field it seemed to contain.
scenes.topology: past trace, moving now, future openness, and field within one boundary
scenes.material_state: integrated gold field with living cyan rail
scenes.camera: pulls back until line and field exchange scale
scenes.u_semantics: The rail remains while strata, traces, and enclosing relation resolve around it.
scenes.t_semantics: Past echoes fade, now moves, and layers coexist.
scenes.audio_volume_semantics: Volume increases coherence across temporal functions.
scenes.audio_beat_semantics: Beats send restrained verification pulses through line and field.
scenes.glance_thesis: Forgetting produces sequence inside a reality wider than forgetting.
scenes.rationale: The final frame preserves ordinary time as a functional local structure.
scenes.risk: Layer density may hide the central reversal.
scenes.review_target: The cyan rail must stay readable inside—not outside—the gold field.
